name: benchmark_crops
description: benchmark_crops is a dataset for evaluating models' ability to identify and classify crop types from imagery across varying conditions (e.g., seasons, sensors, and geographic locations). It measures classification robustness and generalization under domain shift and noise commonly encountered in agricultural and remote-sensing settings. The benchmark is intended to compare model performance on crop-type identification tasks across standardized splits.
reputation: A niche, domain-specific Hugging Face benchmark with limited but practical use among agricultural/remote-sensing researchers.
